create_benchmark_reducer_subclass: create a subclass of BenchmarkReducer implementing join_results, save_results, compute_metrics, save_metrics, and log_metrics abstract methods
run_json_df_reducer: run a JsonDFReducer to join JSON result files into a pandas DataFrame and compute MAE metrics against target data
compute_metrics_forces: compute mean absolute error, cosine similarity, and magnitude error metrics for forces predictions compared to target forces
join_json_results: join multiple JSON result files from a results directory into a single pandas DataFrame using glob pattern matching
save_and_log_metrics: save computed benchmark metrics as compressed JSON and log them to a WandB singleton logger instance
